sources.title: RFC 5545 — iCalendar
sources.version_or_commit: RFC 5545, Standards Track, September 2009; recurrence gap text corrected by verified Erratum 4271 (S12)
locator: §3.2.20 VALUE parameter and unknown value-type tokens, HTML lines 1508–1550
§3.3.10 RRULE UNTIL/COUNT, HTML lines 2156–2175; invalid date/nonexistent local time, lines 2277–2288; computed local recurrence time, lines 2386–2390
§3.8.5.1 EXDATE, HTML lines 6368–6392; §3.8.5.3 recurrence set and duration, lines 6553–6598
sources.observed_operation: Reopened the RFC Editor HTML directly and inspected the listed sections for identity, recurrence algebra, time zones, DST, duration, VALUE parameters, and extension properties.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: UID is the persistent component identifier; RECURRENCE-ID is the original slot and retains its value type; DTSTART/RRULE/RDATE minus EXDATE defines the set, EXDATE wins, and unsynchronized DTSTART/RRULE is undefined. For TZID DTSTART, UNTIL is UTC. DATE-TIME folds select the first instant and explicit gaps use the pre-gap offset. Apply Erratum 4271 (S12) to RRULE-generated gap candidates. Section 3.2.20 covers unknown value-type tokens, not general property-name preservation; sections 3.8.8.1–.2 allow generic consumers to ignore IANA/X-name properties. The RRULE grammar permits UNTIL or COUNT, not both, and COUNT includes DTSTART as its first occurrence.
sources.applicability: Primary file-format contract for the requested adapter; it does not select the product subset, duplicate policy, or guarantee cross-reader behavior.
